declared: 2026-11-28, before any run on the seeds below. Context: diagnosis of the long unicycle Wall paths (results/diagnostics/v2_shortcut/RESULT.md): RRTConnect returns its first solution, and the paper's Alg. 4 connects only the states at the knots of the path, so a detour through a far node survives whenever the bypass of that node collides. Lever L7 (Settings::shortcut_subdivisions / shortcut_rounds) runs further Alg. 4 rounds over states inside the edges and accepts a bypass only if it lowers the LQMT cost. A Python prototype and a native probe on Wall RRTConnect, development seeds 1001-1030, preceded this file; those seeds are therefore not used below.
purpose: L7 is a path-quality lever (Alg. 4 is the paper's path-quality step). It is selected for path length under a time cap, never for closeness to the paper's numbers.
timing: serial, process pinned to config/machine.json measurement_cpu (10); plan_ns + postprocess_ns

included: unicycle_bugtrap and unicycle_wall x rrt_connect, sst_bvp, sst_simd, rrt_dp
quad2d_bugtrap, quad2d_hole, quad3d_block, quad3d_window (r = 4) x rrt_connect, sst_bvp

excluded.quadrotor r = 4 sst_simd, rrt_dp: 6-27 s mean per attempt with frequent budget exhaustion (final_v2c), too costly for a 10-configuration grid; they keep L7 off
excluded.quadrotor r = 2: the paper's reduced-order comparison protocol, kept as in v1
excluded.v1 literal profile: the paper's single Alg. 4 pass by definition

rule: 1. Per (case, algorithm) a configuration is eligible only if it solves every seed the baseline (1, 1) solves and every returned path is valid on the ORIGINAL model (planning.validate; order-4 paths additionally get the interval certificate in the held-out campaign).
2. ... and only if its mean total time is at most 1.5 x the baseline's mean total time on that case (post-processing may add at most half of the planning time).
3. Per (family, algorithm) a configuration must be eligible on every case of the family. Among those, pick the lowest mean over the cases of (mean path length / baseline mean path length).
4. L7 is switched on for that (family, algorithm) only if this normalized length is at most 0.95 (at least 5 % shorter); otherwise it stays off.
5. Tie-break: configurations within 0.01 of the best normalized length -> the lower summed mean time.
6. Never select by closeness to the paper's numbers: lengths are compared with our own baseline only.
held_out: The frozen choice is then measured on seeds low_dof_final_v2d (8101-8130) for every Table I row (unicycle v2 and v1 literal, quadrotors r = 2 and r = 4 with the interval certificate), and the generalization check (config/v2_generalization_rule.json, unchanged) is re-run.
